svg.title: Go at the speed of wisdom
svg.desc: Mindmap. How fast should we develop AI? Go at the speed of wisdom. Four reasons: the risks are real and contested; the world races because it is caught in a collective action trap; we should slow and steer, we partly can, and far more people should decide; wisdom traditions point towards restraint and are strongest on will and process. So every actor should push towards the speed of wisdom with its own lever.

svg.text: Go at the speed of wisdom
Pace AI to the speed at which we can understand, verify and govern it: catastrophe
would be permanent, while most of what delay costs can be recovered.
Rufus Pollock · Wise AI briefing · Draft, October 2026
